bassoon.definitionKo: 두 개의 리드가 있고 목관 악기 가운데 가장 낮은 소리를 내는 악기.
bassoon.englishDescription: An instrument that has two reeds and makes the lowest sound among all the woodwind instruments.

deceit.definitionKo: 실상은 결과가 같은 것을 두고 나쁜 꾀를 써서 다른 것처럼 속임.
deceit.englishDescription: In case where the outcome will be all the same, the act of deceiving others by tricking them into believing that the outcome will be different.

erect.definitionKo: 몹시 화가 나서 눈을 크고 사납게 뜨다.
erect.englishExpression: turn on[provoke/erect/raise] double wicks in one's eyes
erect.englishDescription: To open one's eyes wide and furiously out of violent anger.

katusa.definitionKo: 한국에 머무르고 있는 미국 육군에 소속된 한국 군인.
katusa.englishExpression: KATUSA; Korean Augmentation to the United States Army
katusa.englishDescription: Korean soldiers who serve with the U.S. army stationed in Korea.

legs.definitionKo: 있는 힘을 다하여 매우 다급하게 도망침을 이르는 말.
legs.englishExpression: Legs, please save my life; Steps, please save my life
legs.englishDescription: An exclamation that one says to oneself when running away from danger as fast as one can.

trailer.definitionKo: 견인차에 연결하여 짐이나 사람을 실어 나르는 차.
trailer.englishDescription: A vehicle connected to a pulling car, which is used to carry cargo or people.

web.definitionKo: 동영상이나 음성 등의 여러 정보 매체를 이용하는 인터넷.
web.englishDescription: The Internet which uses a variety of information media such as video or voice, etc.
